nBoard.text: Same board markup. At ≤640px: columns become a scroll-snap row (one column plus a peek of the next). Cost chip hidden (moves into the Workers popover). View switcher icon-only. Floating toolbar starts collapsed.

nCard.text: Same card modal, made full-screen. ID and parent stay left; label and status chips shrink into the top-right. Tabs scroll and drop their icons. The sidebar becomes the Details sheet (panel button at the end of the tab row). Stat tiles go 4 → 2 columns; detail chips wrap under their titles.

nEpic.text: Cards tab: the Done chip moves onto each row's meta line; Dependency chart and Board buttons wrap under the heading.

nReview.text: Round pills: grid 10 → 5 columns. Round headers wrap their counts onto a second line. Same component as the Summary board, opened on Review.

nSheet.text: The sidebar, unchanged, as a bottom sheet over the card. Opens from the panel button; closes by scrim tap, swipe down or ×.

nThread.text: Same card component, Thread tab. Title clamps to 2 lines. Session tabs drop the card-ID prefix and scroll; fullscreen and pop-out hide (the card is already full-screen); 'Ran on SRV' shortens to SRV. Prompt bubble keeps its fade + Show full message. Composer stays pinned with nothing below it.

nFilter.text: Project filter, same on desktop and phone. No 'All projects' control: nothing selected = everything shows. Click a pill to add that project, click again to remove it; any number can be on. Selected pills take a tint of the project colour; unselected ones dim while a filter is active. 'Clear' appears after the pills (phone: an × with the count, pinned before Archived) so the pills never shift under the pointer. Column counts follow the filter.

nNew.text: Same New card modal, made full-screen. Project + base branch stay side by side; the 'work branches off this' hint moves under them. Title and Label stack. Brief placeholder drops ⌘V. Priority keeps its 4-way control with icons above labels; its explanation moves below. Cancel goes (× does it); Ctrl+↵ hint hidden. Footer stays pinned above the keyboard. Inputs are 16px so iOS doesn't zoom.
